Issue: Soft delete does not check children
Example/Proof: category.delete-in-use: category deleted while a test uses it; exam details then show categoryName ''
Risk: Broken references and empty labels in the exam app
Suggested Fix: 409 when in use or cascade soft delete in a transaction

Issue: Company delete does not touch admins, tests, candidates
Risk: Orphan rows remain active; workspace URL is freed and can be reused by a new company
Suggested Fix: Cascade soft delete or block delete while data exists

Issue: Codes generated with MAX()+1 outside a lock
Relation objects override FK columns on update
Example/Proof: tcm.move-test: PATCH testId returns 200, row unchanged
Suggested Fix: Update by id columns without loaded relations

Issue: Group membership stored twice (uuid[] column and join table)
Example/Proof: Entity candidate.entity.ts has groupIds array and ManyToMany groups
Risk: The two can disagree; filters use the array, relations use the table
Suggested Fix: Keep only the join table (or only the array) and index it

Issue: No GIN index for ArrayContains / ArrayOverlap
Example/Proof: pg_indexes: no index on group_ids; assign-groups and group filter scan all company candidates

Issue: Column ranges not enforced (decimal(5,2) overflow -> 500; percentage > 100 allowed)
Risk: Bad results stored or request crashes

Issue: No rule for one centre per candidate per day
Risk: Candidate can be booked twice; login picks whichever centre code is typed
Drafts appear as published in lists and to candidates
Suggested Fix: Default false + CHECK not (is_draft and is_published)

Issue: Question count vs test.total_questions only checked on insert
Risk: Tests can contain more questions than allowed
Suggested Fix: Check on test update as well

Issue: options stored as json with correct answers next to display data
Risk: Any query that forgets to strip answers leaks them (exam paper code strips today)
Suggested Fix: Store answers in a separate column/table

Risk: Schema drift and possible data loss when entities change

Issue: Ordering by updated_at/created_at without index; ILIKE prefix search without index
Example/Proof: EXPLAIN candidates name ILIKE uses company index then filters 1,200 rows
Suggested Fix: Composite indexes (company_id, updated_at) and pg_trgm or lower(name) text_pattern_ops

Issue: Company + first admin created in one transaction; question + content + children in one transaction
Duplicate feedback protected by unique index; parallel submit returns 409 not 500
